loadData

Fetches the animations page chrome node (title + description) for the current locale — the record list itself streams from the components dictionary which is already loaded globally. The route's meta description rides the fetched node so the tag carries the localized text, not the booted shell's.

(module scope)

JSX template — two states: loaded renders the title, intro paragraph and one definition-list row per animation record (alt = term, longdesc = definition); loading renders skeleton rows mirroring the real geometry. Each record carries id so an entry is deep-linkable.
